ayahs.tl: Alif-Laaam-Meeem
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡكِتٰبِ الۡحَكِيۡمِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Hakeem
ayahs.en: These are verses of the wise Book,

ayahs.ar: هُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةً لِّلۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Hudanw wa rahmatal lilmuhsineen
ayahs.en: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُقِيۡمُوۡنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوۡقِنُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yuqeemoonas Salaata wa yu'toonaz Zakaata wa hum bil Aakhirati hum yooqinoon
ayahs.en: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ عَلٰي هُدًي مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika 'alaa hudam mir Rabbihim wa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.en: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنۡ يَّشۡتَرِيۡ لَهۡوَ الۡحَدِيۡثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍࣗۖ وَّيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa minan naasi mai-yashtaree lahuwal hadeesi li yudilla 'an sabeelil laahi bighairi 'ilminw wa yattakhizahaa huzuwaa; ulaaa'ika lahum 'azaabum muheen
ayahs.en: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allah without knowledge and who takes it in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتُنَا وَلّٰي مُسۡتَكۡبِرًا كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَا كَاَنَّ فِيۡ٘ اُذُنَيۡهِ وَقۡرًاۚ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alayhi Aayaatunaa wallaa mustakbiran ka al lam yasma'haa ka anna feee uzunwihi waqran fabash shiru bi'azaabin aleem
ayahs.en: And when our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ النَّعِيۡمِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum Janaatun Na'eem
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure.

ayahs.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقًّاؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Khaalideena feeha wa'dal laahi haqqaa; wa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوۡنَهَا وَاَلۡقٰي فِي الۡاَرۡضِ رَوَاسِيَ اَنۡ تَمِيۡدَ بِكُمۡ وَبَثَّ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍؕ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَنۭۡ بَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ زَوۡجٍ كَرِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Khalaqas samaawaati bi ghairi 'amadin tarawnahaa wa alqaa fil ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wa bassa feehaa min kulli daaabbah; wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa ambatnaa feeha min kulli zawjin kareem
ayahs.en: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا خَلۡقُ اللّٰهِ فَاَرُوۡنِيۡ مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖؕ بَلِ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Haazaa khalqul laahi fa aroonee maazaa khalaqal lazeena min doonih; baliz zaalimoona fee dalalim Mubeen
ayahs.en: This is the creation of Allah. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا لُقۡمٰنَ الۡحِكۡمَةَ اَنِ اشۡكُرۡ لِلّٰهِؕ وَمَنۡ يَّشۡكُرۡ فَاِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Luqmaanal hikmata anishkur lillaah; wa many yashkur fa innamaa yashkuru linafsihee wa man kafara fa innal laaha Ghaniyyun Hameed
ayahs.en: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ لُقۡمٰنُ لِابۡنِهٖ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهٗ يٰبُنَيَّ لَا تُشۡرِكۡ بِاللّٰهِؕؔ اِنَّ الشِّرۡكَ لَظُلۡمٌ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaala luqmaanu libnihee wa huwa ya'izuhoo ya bunaiya laa tushrik billaah; innash shirka lazulmun 'azeem
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice."

ayahs.ar: وَوَصَّيۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ بِوَالِدَيۡهِۚ حَمَلَتۡهُ اُمُّهٗ وَهۡنًا عَلٰي وَهۡنٍ وَّفِصٰلُهٗ فِيۡ عَامَيۡنِ اَنِ اشۡكُرۡ لِيۡ وَلِوَالِدَيۡكَؕ اِلَيَّ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Wa wassainal bi waalidaihi hamalat hu ummuhoo wahnan 'alaa wahninw wa fisaaluhoo fee 'aamaini anishkur lee wa liwaalidaika ilaiyal maseer
ayahs.en: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ جٰهَدٰكَ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ تُشۡرِكَ بِيۡ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَا وَصَاحِبۡهُمَا فِي الدُّنۡيَا مَعۡرُوۡفًاؗ وَّاتَّبِعۡ سَبِيۡلَ مَنۡ اَنَابَ اِلَيَّۚ ثُمَّ اِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَاُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa in jaahadaaka 'alaaa an tushrika bee maa laisa laka bihee 'ilmun falaa tuti'humaa wa saahib humaa fid dunyaa ma'roofanw wattabi' sabeela man anaaba ilayy; summa ilaiya marji'ukum fa unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

ayahs.ar: يٰبُنَيَّ اِنَّهَا٘ اِنۡ تَكُ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ فَتَكُنۡ فِيۡ صَخۡرَةٍ اَوۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ اَوۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ يَاۡتِ بِهَا اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَطِيۡفٌ خَبِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Ya bunaiya innahaaa in taku misqaala habbatim min khardalin fatakun fee sakhratin aw fis samaawaati aw fil ardi yaati bihal laa; innal laaha lateefun Khabeer
ayahs.en: [And Luqman said], "O my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.

ayahs.ar: يٰبُنَيَّ اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ وَاۡمُرۡ بِالۡمَعۡرُوۡفِ وَانۡهَ عَنِ الۡمُنۡكَرِ وَاصۡبِرۡ عَلٰي مَا٘ اَصَابَكَؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عَزۡمِ الۡاُمُوۡرِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaa bunaiya aqimis-Salaata waamur bilma'roofi wanha 'anil munkari wasbir 'alaa maaa asaabaka inna zaalika min 'azmil umoor
ayahs.en: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] determination.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مَرَحًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالٍ فَخُوۡرٍۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tusa'-'ir khaddaka linnaasi wa laa tamshi fil ardi maarahan innal laaha laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor
ayahs.en: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.

ayahs.ar: وَاقۡصِدۡ فِيۡ مَشۡيِكَ وَاغۡضُضۡ مِنۡ صَوۡتِكَؕ اِنَّ اَنۡكَرَ الۡاَصۡوَاتِ لَصَوۡتُ الۡحَمِيۡرِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Waqsid fee mashyika waghdud min sawtik; inna ankaral aswaati lasawtul hameer
ayahs.en: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَوۡا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمۡ مَّا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَاَسۡبَغَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ نِعَمَهٗ ظَاهِرَةً وَّبَاطِنَةًؕ وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنۡ يُّجَادِلُ فِي اللّٰهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍ وَّلَا هُدًي وَّلَا كِتٰبٍ مُّنِيۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Alam taraw annal laaha sakhkhara lakum maa fis sa maawaati wa maa fil ardi wa asbaha 'alaikum ni'amahoo zaahiratanw wa baatinah; wa minan naasi many yujaadilu fil laahi bighayri 'ilminw wa laa hudanw wa laa Kitaabim muneer
ayahs.en: Do you not see that Allah has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ قَالُوۡا بَلۡ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ اٰبَآءَنَاؕ اَوَلَوۡ كَانَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ يَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلٰي عَذَابِ السَّعِيۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa qeela lahumut-tabi'oo maaa anzalal laahu qaaloo bal nattabi'u maa wajadnaa 'alaihi aabaaa'anaa; awalaw kaanash Shaitaanu yad'oohum ilaa 'azaabis sa'eer
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يُّسۡلِمۡ وَجۡهَهٗ٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٌ فَقَدِ اسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِالۡعُرۡوَةِ الۡوُثۡقٰيؕ وَاِلَي اللّٰهِ عَاقِبَةُ الۡاُمُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa many yuslim wajha hooo ilal laahi wa huwa muhsinun faqadistamsaka bil'ur watil wusqaa; wa ilal laahi 'aaqibatul umoor
ayahs.en: And whoever submits his face to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah will be the outcome of [all] matters.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحۡزُنۡكَ كُفۡرُهٗؕ اِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ فَنُنَبِّئُهُمۡ بِمَا عَمِلُوۡاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa man kafara falaa yahzunka kufruh; ilainaa marji'uhum fanunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amiloo; innal laaha 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.en: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.ar: نُمَتِّعُهُمۡ قَلِيۡلًا ثُمَّ نَضۡطَرُّهُمۡ اِلٰي عَذَابٍ غَلِيۡظٍ
ayahs.tl: Numatti'uhum qaleelan summa nadtarruhum ilaa 'azaabin ghaleez
ayahs.en: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُؕ قُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal arda la yaqoolunnal laah; qulil hamdu lillaah; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah "; but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: لِلّٰهِ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الۡغَنِيُّ الۡحَمِيۡدُ
ayahs.tl: Lilaahi ma fis samaa waati wal ard; innal laaha Huwal Ghaniyyul Hameed
ayahs.en: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ اَنَّمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مِنۡ شَجَرَةٍ اَقۡلَامٌ وَّالۡبَحۡرُ يَمُدُّهٗ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ سَبۡعَةُ اَبۡحُرٍ مَّا نَفِدَتۡ كَلِمٰتُ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيۡزٌ حَكِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa law annamaa fil ardi min shajaratin aqlaamunw wal bahru yamudduhoo mim ba'dihee sab'atu abhurim maa nafidat Kalimaatul laah; innal laaha 'azeezun Hakeem
ayahs.en: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

ayahs.ar: مَا خَلۡقُكُمۡ وَلَا بَعۡثُكُمۡ اِلَّا كَنَفۡسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَمِيۡعٌۭ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Maa khalqukum wa laa ba'sukum illaa kanafsinw-waa hidah; innal laaha Samee'um Baseer
ayahs.en: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يُوۡلِجُ الَّيۡلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُوۡلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي الَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَؗ كُلٌّ يَّجۡرِيۡ٘ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي وَّاَنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ خَبِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Alam tara annal laaha yoolijul laila fin nahaari wa yoolijun nahaara fil laili wa sakhkharash shamsa wal qamara kulluny yajreee ilaaa ajalim musammanw wa annal laaha bimaa ta'malona Khabeer
ayahs.en: Do you not see that Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allah, with whatever you do, is Acquainted?

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الۡحَقُّ وَاَنَّ مَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِ الۡبَاطِلُۙ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الۡعَلِيُّ الۡكَبِيۡرُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annal laaha Huwal Haqqu wa anna maa yad'oona min doonihil baatilu wa annal laaha Huwal 'Aliyyul Kabeer
ayahs.en: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّ الۡفُلۡكَ تَجۡرِيۡ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ بِنِعۡمَتِ اللّٰهِ لِيُرِيَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Alam tara annal fulka tajree fil bahri bini'matil laahi li yuriyakum min Aayaatih; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
ayahs.en: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allah that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا غَشِيَهُمۡ مَّوۡجٌ كَالظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ ࣢ۚ فَلَمَّا نَجّٰىهُمۡ اِلَي الۡبَرِّ فَمِنۡهُمۡ مُّقۡتَصِدٌؕ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُوۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa ghashiyahum mawjun kazzulali da'a-wul laaha mukhliseena lahud deena fa lammaa najjaahum ilal barri faminhum muqtasid; wa maa yajhadu bi Aayaatinaa illaa kullu khattaarin kafoor
ayahs.en: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ وَاخۡشَوۡا يَوۡمًا لَّا يَجۡزِيۡ وَالِدٌ عَنۡ وَّلَدِهٖؗ وَلَا مَوۡلُوۡدٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَنۡ وَّالِدِهٖ شَيۡـًٔاؕ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَاࣟ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمۡ بِاللّٰهِ الۡغَرُوۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhan naasuttaqoo Rabbakum wakhshaw Yawmal laa yajzee waalidun 'anw waladihee wa laa mawloodun huwa jaazin 'anw waalidihee shai'aa; innaa wa'dal laahi haqqun falaa taghurran nakumul hayaatud dunyaa wa laa yaghur rannakum billaahil gharoon
ayahs.en: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِۚ وَيُنَزِّلُ الۡغَيۡثَۚ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي الۡاَرۡحَامِؕ وَمَا تَدۡرِيۡ نَفۡسٌ مَّاذَا تَكۡسِبُ غَدًاؕ وَمَا تَدۡرِيۡ نَفۡسٌۭ بِاَيِّ اَرۡضٍ تَمُوۡتُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌ خَبِيۡرٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha 'indahoo 'ilmus saa'ati wa yunazzilul ghaisa wa ya'lamu maa fil arhaami wa maa tadree nafsum maazaa takisbu ghadaa; wa maa tadree nafsum bi ayyi ardin tamoot; innal laaha 'Aleemun Khabeer
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted.
